e8b_stale_lock_reclamation.why_the_pid_check_is_authoritative: the lock records the host it was taken on, and this IS that host, so the absence of the pid here is decisive rather than merely local. On a different node it would prove nothing.
e8b_stale_lock_reclamation.why_not_a_reboot_artefact: the system booted before the lock was created, so the process genuinely exited rather than the machine restarting under it
e8b_stale_lock_reclamation.provenance: left by the unauthorised-optimizer-path execution of 2026-08-07, which was halted and whose artefacts were quarantined. No scientific cell has ever run.
e8b_stale_lock_reclamation.action: removed ONLY this lock; every other lock left untouched (there were none)
e8b_stale_lock_reclamation.reclamation_is_manual_by_design: automatic stale-lock reclaim is deliberately not implemented, because a wrongly reclaimed lock means two processes training one cell
